name: Covert Ops - Beta
objectiveText: Retrieve the Venture Co. Letters from Windshear Mine at the east end of Windshear Crag. Venture Co. Letters  ( 1 )

comments.body:
Both quests are easy enough if you know when and where to pull.  I did both of them by myself.  If you are a druid or rogue, the best thing to do is prowl around the areas so you can get a good idea of where people are, where the plans and letters are, and where to run.

Covert Ops Alpha - The wagon is in front of the mill on a small hill.  It sits by itself and has some firework looking things on top.  For those with Cosmos or map coordinates, the mill is at 66,50.  There are two loggers close to it, so take them out.  Then attach the explosives, blow it up, and run along the bottom of the hill towards the mill.  Not all of the Venture guys will leave, but that's okay.  The plans are on the west/left side of the mill, on a tree stump.  It looks like a piece of rolled-up parchment.  I shifted to cat from as soon as it blew, prowled over to the parchment, shifted up, grabbed it, and ran out with only 1 aggroed Deforester to take care of behind the mill.

Covert Ops Beta - This is a little more difficult than Alpha.  The wagon for this one is on a small hill in front of the mine.  The mine is located at about 74,58 or so.  There are no guards on this wagon, just an operator, and he's far enough away where he won't aggro.  Slightly behind the wagon there is a small hill.  You can blow the wagon if you stand on that hill and keep the wagon to your right.

The letters for this one are on the right/east side of the mine entrance, on a tree stump.  They look like a stack of books.

Here's the trick for Beta...the kobolds don't run when you blow the wagon.  So, you need to kill some of them before setting the explosives.  On the west side of the mine, there is another small hill with three kobolds wandering.  Take them out.  On the east side of the mine, along the ridge, there are two other kobolds.  Take them out too.  There is another kobold closer to the letters, but if you attack him you'll draw the attention of everyone else, so leave him alone.

Run over to the wagon (don't let anyone see you!) and set the explosives.  Get over to the hill and set them off, then take off running.  Head over the hill where you killed the first kobolds, then turn to the mine and get the plans.  Then run AWAY from the mine (I went to the east, along the cliffs).  The kobold you didn't kill will most likely aggro, but if you stop to kill him the rest of the Venture guys will be back and aggro.  Just make sure your health is full and run along the cliffs.  He stops giving chase soon.

Good luck, and I hope this helps!
replies: Right isn't east if you're facing south...

comments.body:
Just to note, you don't actually need to use the explosives/detonator given in this quest, so if something goes wrong (ie: you took too long getting to the quest item and all the mobs went back) you can always clear to the quest item the old fashioned way. The item is right out in plain sight, so the explosives are just a fun and easier way to get the item.

The mine is in the eastern portion of Windshear Crag, so work your way there and in front of the entrance, you'll see the wagon of explosives. Before setting the charge, look at the entrance of the mine, and in front of it (just to the right) you'll see a crate with a clickable item -- that's your quest item.

As a hunter, here's how I did this: before setting the charge, I cleared the mobs to my left (along the mountain/hills) almost up to the quest item. Then I set the red charge on the wagon, moved a bit away (towards where I cleared) and then detonated the wagon. The mobs in the center/front will investigate the explosion, leaving a couple of mobs to clear. I sent my pet to both leftover mobs to distract them and looted the quest item, then ran away, calling my pet to retreat, back the way I came. The two mobs that aggroed chased me, and I killed them when I was at a safe distance from the mine.

QUICK VERSION: Use roots to hold down any mob pounding on you when you get the documents.

DETAILS:
Scout the area (for both quests) as a prowling cat, first, to make sure in your mind where the documents are. For the mine, they're on a box at the foot of the first corner pillar on the *mountain* end.

(Unfortunately, you can't place or trigger the explosives as cat. <8(> )

Get closer than you think as druid -- safely, since you can't prowl! -- and try to trigger bomb. If you are too far away, it will say "Requires explosive" whatever colour. Step once back, try again.

i think there's a wee hillock or small boulder between the waggon and the documents you can stand near. i think you have to be on the waggon side of it to trigger, but i'm not sure.

When it blows, you'll know because you won't get the "Requires..." message and most everyone will start streaming past you. Runrunrun to the documents, rightclick quick, and hope you can open them fast enough.

Probably not. At least one guy will notice you and start pummelling.

If it's a melee-type, *excellent*. Root him quick, then while he stands there and fumes, get the documents. If you can restrain from moonfiring him, even better, so the damage doesn't break the roots. 

Oh, and cast Nature's Grasp on yourself quicklike as you start to run to the documents, so there's a chance an attacker might root himself.

Don't even *think* about sticking around afterwards. Run, in any form, away.

If you're getting plinked by axes, that's bothersome. Then it's pretty near impossible, because every plink will disrupt your opening the documents. You may as well either fight it out and die, or run away.

i think the closest guy left, though, to notice you as you nick the docs is a melee-type.

If you couldn't get the documents, for whatever reason, no sweat. Abandon "Covert Ops - Beta", then go back to the gnome and get it again. You'll get another whole satchel, with *everything* for *both* quests.

Whilst i didn't need to try it, i suspect that should a second attempt fail, you could use the remaining explosive at the mine, too. (Instead of at the mill as it was intended.)

Rinse and repeat until you get the documents. Roots and prowl are your friends!

Even better, of course, would be to help someone with their quota of loggers, etc., in exchange for them holding mobs off you whilst you get the documents.

I only have a lvl 24 rogue and was able to do this on the first attempt.  Just stealth around until you find the documents outside the mine.  Go to the wagon to the north and plant the explosives (right-click on the explosives when you are butted up next to the back of the wagon).  This will cause you to "de-stealth".  There may be one mob you have to clear out from the wagon first.  Not bad.  Then go south and kill the single mob next to the stumps to the north east of the mine.  That will be your hiding place.  Face the wagon and hit the detonator!  Wagon explodes, half of the mob runs out.  Stealth back up to the area with the documents and kill the guy that is just west of them.  Turn around and grab documents.  The other mob near the mine entrance should have his back to you.  If he doesn't he may come after you.  Do not go after him as this will aggro the other mob by him.  If you have to deal with him it is likely you will have very little time to get the documents.  When you do, just grab them and hit vanish if you have been noticed.  Really not that hard.

Read my post under Covert Ops: Alpha for info on this as well as how to use the explosives...

SHORT VERSION: Use Roots to hold down the mob attacking you so you can get the documents.

LONG VERSION: Make extensive use of Prowl to make sure you know exactly where the documents are.

They're at the far end, near the hillside, on a box at the corner pillar. They're *surrounded*.

Unfortunately, cat can't set or trigger the bomb. 8(

After setting the bomb, go toward the documents, *carefully*. i think i remember a wee hillock or small boulder roughly halfway between the waggon and the documents. Try from there -- if you are too far away, a message will appear "Requires ---" whatever the damn stuff is called. Take a step back and try again.

You'll know it triggered because you won't get that message and nearly everyone will be running past you. 

Runrunrun -- but carefully between those going teh other way! -- to the documents. If you're lucky, you can rightclick and open the suckers before someone hits you. If someone hits you just as the loot window opens, *ignore them*. Get the loot and scarper!

If they disrupt your opening of the documents, Root them in place. Cast Nature's Grasp on yourself so that there's a chance that an attacker will immobilise himself if he hits you. Try to resist Moonfiring him, you want the roots to hold as long as possible.

Whilst he's being Rooted, get the documents. *Don't* stop to fight him, just run in whatever form you like.

If, by some bad luck, the mob that noticed you is plinking you with axes instead of pummelling you, you won't be able to get the documents (the axes will keep disrupting you). And by the time you clear him out, everyone else is piling on. You may as well die fighting, or run clear right off.

If you blow up the waggon but can't get the documents, no problem. Abandon "Covert Ops - Beta", then go to the gnome and get it again. He'll give you another *whole* satchel, with everything in it for both missions.

i suspect, but did not verify, that you could use the bomb meant for the mill on the mine if you had to. So you could just keep going back to the gnome for more bombs if you have to.

comments.body:
When you accept this quest a black bag will be placed in your inventory. This bag contains the instructions, as well as explosives and detonators for both Covert Ops A and Covert Ops B quests. To get these out of your bag you click on them, and accept the question asking if you want to bind them to you. This takes them from the bag and places them in your regular inventory to be used.

The letters themselves are found on top of a crate in front of the mine entrance. They are pretty easy to spot. The wagon is out a ways north east of the mine entrance.

You place the explosives on the wagon by getting close to it and right-clicking on the wagon. We then approached the mine by coming in from the east and killing a couple mobs to get in closer before detonating the wagon.

This one is harder than Alpha for two reasons:

1. The mobs are higher level.

2. As with Alpha a few mobs will stay behind when most go to investigate. As an added bonus, you also have the chance of mobs from within the mine entrance wandering out to interfere with things as you are trying to get the letters.

Having a partner to do this with was very helpful, as the mobs seemed to return from the wagon more quickly than they did in Alpha. Without a partner, I would not have been able to clear a path to the letter before they returned.

Completing this quest is worth 2,200 exp.

The documents aren't inside the mine, but outside slightly east of the the part of the building that has legs. Find the cart with explosives and move your cursor to the left of the wooden part of the building and the cursor should turn to a cog-wheel over a brown chest. Then use the explosives while on the cart and move away and use the detonator . If you get a message "requires NG-5 explosives" you are too far away. Sadly you cannot use blue explosives instead of red, but you can abandon the quest and reaquire it to get more red explosive.
Still for my 27 level priest, I could not get to the documents fast enough before enough mobs returned and killed me. In the end I did it the old-fashioned way...kill those around the documents and get them.

A troll hunter was around, we took turns killing and clearing and then she showed me where the letters were, to the left and down and under from looking at the mine entrance.

Except one brief moment when both our pets/minions had a brief tangle, it was very smooth.

Never could get the explosives to go off, did not realize that there was a range issue.

The beta documents are far enough away from the entrance that if you go after them from the far side you should not draw the attention of any of the kobalds.

It was interesting.  Did not realize that the detonators had such a short range, I kept trying to set them up and then gave up on them because they would never work, I got a silly error message "requires" rather than an "out of range" which would have cued me in.  Guess I should have read all of this first.

Kind of fun.

...follow the river, then go south to the mountains and follow them east. Much easier dealing with the Cliff Stormers (or whathever they are) than it is to fight through a bajillion axe throwers and casters.

To complete this one, I did what I should have done for Alpha: Cheat. (A level 21 Deuid is barely able to handle two foes of her level, and they'd often attack in waves of three or four.) So, I got someone who [i]could [/i] handle them, my level 60 Warrior. Logged out on a little hillock, logged in as Big Brother, wiped out the targets surrounding the documents, turned into a cat and Prowled my way to Gaxim.

Am I proud? No. Did I complete the rather annoying quest? Yes. The next one requires you to kill Fire elementals, and I thinhk I'm up to the task. [i]THEY [/i] don't mob.
